concerns.text: FR-011 requires validating SSS against 'a held-out subset of human-annotated transcripts'. The plan.md, research.md, and data-model.md completely omit any mechanism, dataset, or task for acquiring or using human annotations. The plan substitutes 'mock scores' (per kickback notes) which violates the requirement for real human validation. This is an unbacked FR.

FR-001 mandates downloading from 'Voices-in-the-Wild-2M'. The plan explicitly rejects this dataset as 'unverified' and substitutes 'OpenASR-Leaderboard' and 'LibriSpeech'. While the substitution is scientifically sound for CI, the plan fails to explicitly map this change to a spec amendment or provide a traceable justification that the new datasets satisfy the 'stratified subset' and '54 scenarios' coverage requirements of FR-001. The spec remains the root cause of the mismatch.

SC-001 requires measuring R² against a 'held-out test set'. The plan describes training a regression model but does not explicitly define the data split strategy (e.g., 80/20 split, stratified by clip) required to create this held-out set. The data-model.md defines entities but lacks the 'split' entity or logic to satisfy the measurement condition of SC-001.
